cards.text: Untuk kepemilikan, hubungan keluarga, penyakit, dan janji temu, have dan have got sama artinya. Bentuk ini tidak dipakai dengan -ing.

examples.en: I have a sister. / I've got a sister.
She has a headache. / She's got a headache.

cards.trap: Bukan We're having a nice room. Untuk lampau pakai had (tanpa got): I had long hair.

cards.text: Kalimat tanya dan negatif: Do you have ...? / Have you got ...? dan I don't have ... / I haven't got .... Untuk lampau pakai did/didn't.

examples.en: Do you have any questions? / Have you got any questions?
Did you have a car when you lived in Bali?
examples.id: Apakah kamu punya mobil waktu tinggal di Bali?

cards.text: have (tanpa got) juga dipakai untuk kegiatan dan pengalaman: have breakfast, have a shower, have a rest, have a party, have a good time. Ungkapan ini boleh memakai -ing, dan kalimat tanya/negatifnya memakai do/does/did.

questions.why: Untuk kepemilikan dan hubungan keluarga, pakai Do you have (atau Have you got), tidak memakai -ing.

questions.prompt: Lisa ___ (have) long hair when she was a child.
questions.why: Bentuk lampau have untuk kepemilikan adalah had (tanpa got).

questions.prompt: We're having a nice room in this hotel.
questions.answer: We have a nice room in this hotel.
accept: We've got a nice room in this hotel.
questions.why: have yang berarti "punya" tidak dipakai dengan -ing.

questions.prompt: I can't come to work today. I've ___ a bad cold.
questions.why: Untuk penyakit, have got sama dengan have: I've got a bad cold.
have breakfast adalah kegiatan, jadi negatifnya memakai don't (bukan haven't).

questions.prompt: ___ (you / have) a car when you lived in Bali?
questions.why: Pertanyaan lampau tentang kepemilikan memakai Did you have.

pairs: a good time at the party?
a headache. Can I lie down?
lunch now. Can I call you back?
questions.why: have got untuk kepemilikan dan penyakit; have untuk kegiatan (boleh -ing); lampau memakai did.
Hubungan keluarga memakai has atau has got (untuk he/she).

questions.prompt: Sometimes I ___ a sandwich for lunch.
questions.why: have yang berarti makan adalah kegiatan, jadi tidak memakai got.

questions.prompt: Had you trouble finding the hotel?
questions.answer: Did you have trouble finding the hotel?
questions.why: have trouble adalah pengalaman, jadi kalimat tanyanya memakai did.
